Many families & communities in @SacCountyCA have been impacted by fentanyl-related deaths of loved ones & friends.

Go to @SacCountyDA's #1PillCanKill website for important info about identifying deadly fentanyl, preventing overdose & seeking treatment ⬇️
https://t.co/io2dEXqyk4

Americans count on @USPS to conduct business, get prescription medications, exercise their right to vote, and more.
 
The bipartisan #PostalServiceReformAct is critical to ensuring my constituents get their mail on time. Today, I’m voting YES for a better USPS for my district. https://t.co/1tuDQMFJ4G

Eating disorders take an enormous toll on a person’s mental and physical health. In seeking help, sufferers need our health care system to recognize eating disorders as complex illnesses and understand that the road to recovery begins with comprehensive treatment approach.

I’m proud to join @RepKClark to introduce the Into the Light Maternal Mental Health and Substance Use Disorders Act.
 
This critical bill would allow providers to expand behavioral health screening and treatment for pregnant and postpartum women/mothers throughout the country.

I'm proud to co-lead the #988Implementation Act, which includes my bill, the Excellence in Mental Health and Addiction Treatment Act. 

This initiative would ensure that when someone calls for help, they can talk with a trained professional or be connected with local services. https://t.co/TsMWpSv5aM

During this week’s @EnergyCommerce Health Subcommittee hearing, I spoke about my bill, the Anna Westin Legacy Act, which would increase training and education for health professionals on eating disorders and improve screening, intervention, referrals, and treatment for youth. https://t.co/Z2Nqdm3rrH

June is Alzheimer’s & Brain Awareness Month! Early diagnosis of Alzheimer's is critical to getting people the best possible care & supporting their caregivers. Last year, I introduced the CHANGE Act that provides a roadmap for us to take steps forward to prevent, treat & #ENDALZ.

The #RestoringHope for Mental Health and Well-Being Act provides aid for adult suicide prevention services and treatment for those with serious mental illnesses, mental health support for pregnant and postpartum women, and more.  

I'm proud to vote YES on this legislation today. https://t.co/WofdmU119I

The OAA provides a variety of support to older Americans, including nutrition services, economic security, and caregiver support. TFAF is a leader in ensuring that we are providing ample resources and funding for these programs, especially as Americans grow older and live longer.

Today I’m attending the @WhiteHouse Conference on Food, Nutrition, and Health to work with the Biden-Harris Administration towards ending hunger and building a healthy future for all Americans. https://t.co/LgFoNT8ISN

It was great meeting with Chef @mulvaneyp and Chef Santana Diaz of @ucdavishealth today.
 
I’m proud to have joined them at the @WhiteHouse Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, and Health yesterday to make sure that Sacramento's ideas shined as an example to follow. https://t.co/VMGWcmjaNJ
In Sacramento, we’ve long realized the importance of accessible, healthy, local food. We’ve focused on food security and nutrition as being crucial pieces to positive health outcomes.

In 2014, I led the effort to establish the Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinic (CCBHC) program through my bill, the Excellence in Mental Health Act. Since then, CCBHCs have proven their ability to close the treatment gap and provide care when and where it's needed most.

By expanding the CCBHC program to the Sacramento region, we’re increasing access to high-quality mental health & addiction care. We're giving trusted providers, like @WellSpaceHealth, the resources to address complex treatment challenges & better serve patients across our region.

October is National #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth— a month to spread awareness & continue building a robust network of support in our communities.
 
I'll continue to work hard in Congress to ensure that communities have the tools & screenings needed for early detection & treatment. https://t.co/GlKg5QpPvq

We must do all we can to end hunger & create a healthy future in our country & around the world.
 
I was grateful to attend The @WhiteHouse Conference on Food, Nutrition, & Health last month to bring Sacramento's ideas on how food as medicine helps our communities. #WorldFoodDay https://t.co/D1WDAxNznX

Today, the House passed @RepGuthrie and my bill, the Early Hearing Detection and Intervention Act, which reauthorizes the program for early detection, diagnosis, and treatment of deaf and hard-of-hearing newborns, infants, and young children.

Although the State of Emergency in California has ended, it's still important to keep yourself and your loved ones safe from COVID-19.

Keep testing as needed, get your vaccines, and seek treatment as needed ⬇️
https://t.co/d3MghBnCm6

This #LaborDay, we celebrate the American workforce. Your dedication and achievements power our nation's progress.

I’m proud to stand with a new generation of workers as they exercise their collective strength and make their voices heard. https://t.co/2c4wZ3i3hw

October is #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth. If you’re over the age of 40, or have symptoms at any age, you may qualify for free or low-cost screenings that could save your life.

Check your eligibility and schedule a screening today ⬇️
https://t.co/2CtYXkjdSi

Did you know that offering #telehealth for mental health treatments results in more patient visits?

My bill, the Telemental Health Care Access Act, would expand Medicare’s mental health care coverage to give patients more flexibility in treatment options.
https://t.co/mDyhTjqTMI

Recently, I visited Galt to highlight @sac_coe and @SacPublicHealth’s “Schools as Centers of Wellness” program.

As a long-time fighter for improving our nation’s mental health care, I support @SacCountyCA's innovative efforts to address youth mental health in our community. https://t.co/ZhSb0Bj7qz

It’s 1 a.m.  Yet, the Republicans feel the best time to strip millions of their health care, roll back environmental protections, slash food and nutrition assistance, and further deepen the tech divide in rural America is while you sleep. They have one mission, get Trump his tax cuts. I will continue to make this as painful as possible for them.

I met with Alchemist CDC Executive Director Sam Greenlee for a trip to the Florin Farmers Market. Our farmers markets are world-class, and are also a lifeline for Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) recipients.

If the Republicans follow through with their plan to cut $300 billion from SNAP, these markets and our families will suffer greatly. I will keep fighting to make sure that your food security and small business aren’t sacrificed so the richest Americans can get richer.

Republicans are cheering nearly $1 trillion in cuts to Medicaid—but every dollar slashed means real human suffering.

A senior forced out of a nursing home.
A pregnant mom losing care for miles around.
A veteran denied mental health support.
A child with a disability left behind.

While Senate Republicans take a victory lap, real people will pay the price. I will never back down from this fight. I will emphatically vote NO on the Big Ugly Bill.
